title: Clinical Coverage Policy — Qualification and Setup of Home Oxygen Therapy
content:
# Qualification and Setup — Home Oxygen Therapy

## 1. Qualifying test

Home Oxygen Therapy qualifies when the qualifying test shows saturation at or below the group I value (group I), or equal to the group II value with a documented qualifying comorbidity (group II), and was performed no more than the class's test lookback days before the order date.

## 2. Portable equipment

Portable equipment is billable only when mobility within the home is documented, where the class requires mobility documentation for portable equipment. An order for sleep-only use never qualifies for portable equipment.

## 3. Written order

A written order older than the class's written-order validity months cannot start oxygen.

## 4. Setup

Setup is made within the class's setup lead hours of a complete order, on the day of hospital discharge where the class guarantees same-day discharge setup, by a respiratory therapist where the class requires it, and leaves the class's number of emergency backup cylinders.

## 5. Prior authorization

When the primary coverage's class requires prior authorization for oxygen, oxygen is set up only once a prior authorization request on this oxygen record is approved and the setup date is within the coverage's prior-authorization validity days of its decision date.

- Basis: the system record — the request type, its status and decision date, and the oxygen record the request is filed on, together with the coverage class.
- Correlation: the request must be on this oxygen record.

## 6. Current eligibility

> Clause no longer in force for the setup of a system that has been delivered while its oxygen record still shows the order as awaiting setup: "Oxygen is set up only when the coverage's last eligibility check is within that coverage class's eligibility re-verification days before the setup date." Every other setup remains under this clause.

- Basis, where the clause applies: the system record — the last eligibility check date on the coverage record that the setup names.

## Judgement table for a setup

| Point | Holds when |
|---|---|
| Prior authorization (only where the coverage class requires it for oxygen) | an approved prior authorization request on this oxygen record exists, and the setup date is within the validity days of its decision date |
| Eligibility (setups that remain under the clause in section 6) | the coverage's last eligibility check is within the class's re-verification days before the setup date |

## Hypothetical qualifying results

| Test result | Comorbidity documented | Group |
|---|---|---|
| saturation at or below the group I value | either | group I |
| saturation equal to the group II value | yes | group II |

A result equal to the group II value without a documented qualifying comorbidity is not listed as qualifying under either group by this policy.

## Points of judgement

**Does a qualifying result alone qualify?** Not on its own: the test must also have been performed no more than the lookback days before the order date.

**May an order for sleep-only use carry portable equipment?** No; an order for sleep-only use never qualifies for portable equipment.
